subject: Yeah seen that one  a few times, I call'em back in timers...
author: SUFFUR
body:
I have over a hundred pictures of freeze outs (could be more), some cool, some basic. I always take pictures of my freeze outs, on all games. Got some great Rainbow 6 ones too. There are the odd, look at that weird glitch, bug moment too. With a terrorist humping a door frame, lol.

I have less taken on my Elite console, so that must say something, then again since my connection started to work, I have less and less, which says something else, I thought freeze outs were to do with loss of connections, IMO. 

I may up-load them to the flickr, sometime, but due to some issue with my computer I have some duplicates, so will need to sort some of them.

Does anyone else do this, or just ones that are bizzare?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
